question: What is the primary function of the WTO?

options.text: To liberalise international trade and ensure fair practices

solution:
The correct answer is __**To liberalise international trade and ensure fair practices**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) is an international body that governs global trade rules and agreements between member countries.
 
• Its primary objective is to liberalise international trade by reducing trade barriers such as tariffs, quotas, and subsidies, while ensuring fair competition.
 
• The WTO provides a platform for trade negotiations, dispute resolution, and transparency in trade policies to ensure smooth and predictable trade flows.
 
• It addresses unfair trade practices, including dumping and subsidies, which distort market competition, promoting a level playing field for all member nations.
 
• The WTO also assists developing countries with technical training and capacity-building programs to help them integrate into the global trading system effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Formation and Membership:**

 
 
• The WTO was established on January 1, 1995, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT).
 
• It currently has 164 member countries, accounting for over 98% of global trade as of 2023.
 
 
 
• **Core Principles:**
 
 
• The WTO operates on principles such as non-discrimination, free trade, and transparency to foster predictable and fair trade practices globally.
 
• It promotes the Most Favoured Nation (MFN) principle, ensuring equal treatment of all trading partners.
